source: August_Version/configs/august_<rep>_direct_c4.json. Identical across PCA/SpiralNet/Adaptive except the memory-driven batch sizes in representation_overrides. These produced the August anchors (pca128/spiralnet128/adaptive128 direct_c4 s42_v2).
trainer_semantics: August train_c4.py: early-stopping patience counts genuine (unconstrained) score improvement; best.pt is the best feasible epoch; best_unconstrained.pt is also kept.

selection.primary: macro CN/AD first-to-last decoded transport shape ratio

notes.lamm128: No August-recipe LAMM run exists. Batch 96 / decoder 512 is what the earlier LAMM cocycle (task3_v3_lamm_latest, older recipe) ran with, so it fits in memory.
notes.min_selection_epoch_sensitivity: Extra checkpoint best_min_epoch.pt: best feasible epoch at or after this epoch (the anchors selected epochs 1-5, before the 10/15-epoch ramps finish). Reported as a sensitivity analysis; best.pt stays primary.
